Class DokkuController

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs156.frontiers.controllers.ApiController
edu.ucsb.cs156.frontiers.controllers.DokkuController
@RequestMapping("/api/dokku") @RestController public class DokkuController extends ApiController
Endpoints that produce files for setting up access to the UCSB Dokku servers (dokku-00 through dokku-18).

      public static String usernameFromEmail(String email)
      Extracts the dokku username from an email address: everything before the first @. An email with no @ is returned unchanged.
      Parameters:
      email - the email address
      Returns:
      the username

    • usernameFor

      public static String usernameFor(String email, Map<String,String> translations)
      Returns the dokku username for an email: the translated username if there is a DokkuAccountTranslation for the email (compared in canonical form), otherwise the part of the email before the @.
      Parameters:
      email - the email address
      translations - map from canonical email to dokku username
      Returns:
      the dokku username

    • dokkuNameForTeam

      public static Optional<String> dokkuNameForTeam(String teamName)
      Returns the dokku instance named by a team, if the team name has the form xxx-yy and yy is between LOWEST_DOKKU_NUMBER and HIGHEST_DOKKU_NUMBER inclusive.
      Parameters:
      teamName - the team name, e.g. "s26-07"
      Returns:
      the dokku instance name, e.g. "dokku-07", or empty if the team does not correspond to a dokku instance
